evidence_snippets: Using persistent storage in your GKE on AWS workloads In GKE on AWS, you use the Kubernetes PersistentVolume (PV), PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC), and StorageClass resources to provide persistent file and block storage to workloads.
VolumeSnapshotClass Clusters have a default Kubernetes VolumeSnapshotClass that creates snapshots of stateful storage on EBS volumes.
You can create snapshots of persistent storage with the VolumeSnapshot and VolumeSnapshotClass resources.
